core_result: Machine-checks 19 headline theorems (T1a-T1e, T2a-T2f, T3a-T3d, T4a-T4d) + master conjunction prove_all_terrace_theorems (20 Palomar targets) plus 4 NonVacuity witnesses and 6 AdversarialTests sharpness refutations (30 audited declarations, zero Mathlib, zero native_decide, all 6 independent Lean 4.35.0 proof kernels verified on Ubuntu CI run 45859629245, SLSA #72758106 / Rekor 4129728240) across four coupled pillars in generalized Cayley-Dickson algebras CD_n(gamma) of arbitrary signature gamma in {+1,-1}^n: (I) Universal Nilpotent Mirror Conservation (T1a-T1e): all-n sign cocycle factorization sigma_n^gamma(i,j) = sigma_n^std(i,j)*chi_n(i&j&flip), k-independent 2x2 block-sign flip, 2-blade nilpotency criterion (Lean states the scalar part: sigma(i,i)+sigma(j,j)=0 <=> parity_n((i^j)&flip)=1), universal all-n Nilpotent Mirror-Inversion Law (nu^gamma = nu^std or 2^(n-1)-nu^std), and Mirror-Pair Conservation & Midpoint Stratum Invariance; (II) The Dyadic-Palindromic Terrace Law (T2a-T2f): exact 4-branch 2-blade nullity doubling recurrence (all n >= 2), 4 | nu_n^std (the 2-blade case of Moreno's multiple-of-four theorem, re-proved in Lean) and attained ceiling 2^(n-1)-4, which is below the Biss-Dugger-Isaksen bound 2^n-4n+4 for all n >= 5 (among n >= 4, equal only at n=4), closed-form all-n mass M_n = 8(2^(n-1)-1)(2^(n-2)-1)(2^(n-3)-1) and non-ZD count H_n^std(0) = (6n-9)2^(n-2)+3, exact even/odd bin interleaving & interior palindrome (all n >= 3), top terrace bin H_{n+1}(2^n-4) = 2H_n(0) & jump +3(2^n-2), and the Universal All-Signature Midpoint 42 Law H_n^gamma(2^(n-2)) = 42*2^(n-4) for all n >= 4 and all signatures gamma; (III) Coordinate right-multiplier families in the Euclidean CD_n (T3a-T3d): exact doubling of right-compatibility graph G_n^comp & unique universal right-multipliers {e_0, e_{2^(n-1)}}, exact clique number omega(G_n^comp) = n+5 for all n >= 3, Hurwitz-Radon saturation at n in {3,4,5} (8,9,10) and, by arithmetic on the classical formula, n+5 < rho(2^n) with deficit >= n-5 for all n >= 6 (11 < 12 at n=6), so coordinate families fall short of rho(2^n) from dimension 64 on, and constructive [2^n, n+5, 2^n] & asymmetric doubling tower [2^(n-1), 2(n+4), 2^n] pairs; and (IV) Complete Finite Certificates & Rigidity (T4a-T4d): Sedenion Triple-42 & Fano 7+28+7=42 Duality across all 2^16 coordinate subspaces with 0 of dim >= 11, 42 box-kite assessors forming de Marrais's 7 box-kites, each K_{2,2,2} (4-regular, 84 edges; formal re-verification of a known result) & 9D norm-multiplicative O + R*e_8, complete split-phase classifications of CD_4(gamma) (1:1:7:7) & CD_5(gamma) (4x1 + 4x7), and certified [14,14,32] Pathion & [16,16,64] Chingon witnesses + elementary lemmas that c^2=1 forces c=+-1 in integral domains, Z and Z[i]. Differentially verified across all 496 algebras CD_4(gamma)-CD_8(gamma) (with C1 interior spectral gaps for n >= 6 and C2 certified zero-gap HiGHS MILP Pathion symmetric ceiling r_max(CD_5) = 14 < 16 (a bound for symmetric coordinate subsets of CD_5, outside Lean; not comparable to Yiu's general [16,16,32] formula)) in zero-dependency Rust (3-OS CI), strict ISO C11 (-std=c11 -Werror, ASan+UBSan, 100k fuzz), and exact Q Python oracle (3-OS CI, 10/10 pytest + Hypothesis + algebraic mutation kills + 0 ruff / 0 mypy), accompanied by 22/24 bibliography identifiers resolve live (titles are not compared by the checker; 2 entries have no identifier), 17-page 0-warning AMS-LaTeX PDF + clean-room arXiv tarball, live 3D WebGL Observatory & Proof Blueprint on GitHub Pages, and 100.0% (68/68) Build Standard v1.2.0 compliance.
